data.title: Business Identity Takeover — Rapid Signer, Address, and Banking Detail Changes on Established Account
data.description: Detects potential business identity takeover by identifying a cluster of critical account changes occurring within a short window on established commercial accounts. The rule flags accounts where authorized signer changes, business address updates, and banking detail modifications (routing/account number, wire instructions, or beneficiary changes) all occur within 14 days — a pattern strongly indicative of corporate hijacking. Threat actors impersonate legitimate businesses by filing fraudulent amendments with the Secretary of State to change registered agents or officers, then use the hijacked identity to modify banking relationships and extract funds. Established accounts (open 12+ months) are specifically targeted because they have built credit history and banking relationships that actors exploit. This pattern was heavily observed during pandemic-era PPP/EIDL fraud and continues to plague commercial lenders. Average commercial loan fraud via business identity theft ranges from $100K to $1M+.

detection.condition: selection AND filter_account_age AND filter_signer_change AND filter_address_change AND filter_banking_detail_change

enrichment_required.source: Account modification audit log — signer change event within 14-day window
Account modification audit log — address change event within 14-day window
Account modification audit log — routing/account/wire instruction change within 14-day window
Secretary of State data — whether business had officer or agent amendment within 60 days

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Business Identity Takeover
// Detects clustered signer + address + banking detail changes on established commercial accounts
(account_type="commercial" OR account_type="business_checking" OR account_type="business_savings" OR account_type="commercial_line_of_credit")
account_age_months>=12
authorized_signer_change_within_window="true"
business_address_change_within_window="true"
banking_detail_change_within_window="true"
| first_change_to_last_change_days := dateDiff(last_modification_date, first_modification_date)
| groupBy(account_id, function=[
    collect([business_name, tax_id, account_type, account_open_date,
             authorized_signer_names, business_address,
             modification_date, modification_type, modified_by_user,
             modification_channel, sos_recent_amendment_flag])
  ])
| sort(first_change_to_last_change_days, order=asc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Business Identity Takeover")`
`comment("Detects clustered signer, address, and banking detail changes on established commercial accounts")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:commercial_account_management
  (account_type="commercial" OR account_type="business_checking"
   OR account_type="business_savings" OR account_type="commercial_line_of_credit")
| eval account_age_months = round((now() - strptime(account_open_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 2592000)
| where account_age_months >= 12
| eval change_category = case(
    modification_type IN ("authorized_signer_add", "authorized_signer_remove", "authorized_signer_change"), "signer",
    modification_type IN ("business_address_change", "mailing_address_change", "registered_address_change"), "address",
    modification_type IN ("routing_number_change", "wire_instruction_change", "beneficiary_change", "account_link_change"), "banking_detail",
    1=1, "other")
| where change_category IN ("signer", "address", "banking_detail")
| stats dc(change_category) AS change_types
    min(_time) AS first_change max(_time) AS last_change
    values(modification_type) AS all_modifications
    values(modified_by_user) AS modifying_users
    values(modification_channel) AS channels
    BY account_id, business_name, tax_id
| eval window_days = round((last_change - first_change) / 86400)
| where change_types >= 3 AND window_days <= 14
| eval risk_score = case(
    window_days <= 3 AND isnotnull(mvfind(channels, "online|api")), "critical",
    window_days <= 7, "high",
    1=1, "high")
| table account_id, business_name, tax_id, change_types, window_days,
        all_modifications, modifying_users, channels, risk_score
| sort - risk_score window_days
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Business Identity Takeover
-- Detects clustered signer + address + banking detail changes on established accounts
WITH account_changes AS (
  SELECT
    am.account_id,
    a.business_name,
    a.tax_id,
    a.account_type,
    a.account_open_date,
    DATEDIFF(MONTH, a.account_open_date, CURRENT_DATE) AS account_age_months,
    am.modification_type,
    am.modification_date,
    am.modified_by_user,
    am.modification_channel,
    CASE
      WHEN am.modification_type IN ('authorized_signer_add', 'authorized_signer_remove', 'authorized_signer_change') THEN 'signer'
      WHEN am.modification_type IN ('business_address_change', 'mailing_address_change', 'registered_address_change') THEN 'address'
      WHEN am.modification_type IN ('routing_number_change', 'wire_instruction_change', 'beneficiary_change', 'account_link_change') THEN 'banking_detail'
    END AS change_category
  FROM account_modifications am
  JOIN commercial_accounts a ON am.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE a.account_type IN ('commercial', 'business_checking', 'business_savings', 'commercial_line_of_credit')
    AND DATEDIFF(MONTH, a.account_open_date, CURRENT_DATE) >= 12
    AND am.modification_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -14, CURRENT_DATE)
    AND am.modification_type IN (
      'authorized_signer_add', 'authorized_signer_remove', 'authorized_signer_change',
      'business_address_change', 'mailing_address_change', 'registered_address_change',
      'routing_number_change', 'wire_instruction_change', 'beneficiary_change', 'account_link_change'
    )
),
account_summary AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    business_name,
    tax_id,
    account_type,
    account_age_months,
    COUNT(DISTINCT change_category) AS distinct_change_types,
    MIN(modification_date) AS first_change,
    MAX(modification_date) AS last_change,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, MIN(modification_date), MAX(modification_date)) AS window_days
  FROM account_changes
  WHERE change_category IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY account_id, business_name, tax_id, account_type, account_age_months
)
SELECT *
FROM account_summary
WHERE distinct_change_types >= 3
  AND window_days <= 14
ORDER BY window_days ASC

falsepositives: Legitimate business acquisitions or mergers resulting in rapid ownership and banking changes
Business relocations with concurrent signer updates due to organizational restructuring
Seasonal businesses reactivating dormant accounts with updated contact and banking information
Court-ordered changes following business litigation or estate proceedings
